overall: The AG found the Somerset Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving its May 13, 2025 minutes only at its August 26, 2025 meeting, the fourth meeting later, so it was not timely. The Board was ordered to comply immediately and in the future.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve the minutes of its May 13, 2025 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges, and we agree, that it failed to timely approve the minutes of the May 13, 2025, meeting where the minutes were approved during the meeting held on August 26, 2025, which was the fourth meeting thereafter.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
